company.shortDescription: Winden is a financial technology company that offers banking products for entrepreneurs and businesses.
company.description: Winden is a financial technology company that offers banking products for entrepreneurs and businesses. The company provides deposit banking, spend management, and other financial products for digital freelancers, agencies, and more. Its products are primarily aimed at single-person e-commerce businesses, but it also caters to digital freelancers and agencies. Winden offers digital entrepreneurs features such as free ACH, wire and check payments and the ability to manage transactions, payments and expenses in one place.
